title: Add autonomy soak tick CLI
summary: Add a scheduler-friendly autonomy soak tick CLI for health polling and explicit snapshot recording.
reason: The 7-day and 30-day autonomy plan needs a single low-risk command that scheduled tasks can run to poll health, optionally record trend snapshots, and return deterministic exit codes without changing launch, queue, publish, cleanup, or media behavior.
behavior_before: Health gating and snapshot recording were separate tools; a soak scheduler had to compose them externally and could not get a single health/snapshot/exit-code payload.
behavior_after: A bundled Python soak tick tool can evaluate autonomy health with history, optionally record a bounded diagnostics-state snapshot, and return scheduler-friendly exit codes.
